subject: Double charged on September 15th invoice
body:
Hi Support,

Looking at our bank statement, our card was charged twice ($320 each) on September 15th for invoice #INV-9940. Please reverse the duplicate charge immediately.

Marcus Vance

subject: Gmail freezing when opening Hiver shared draft
body:
Hello,

Whenever our agents try to edit a shared draft on emails with large PDF attachments (>15MB), the entire Gmail tab freezes and crashes with 'Out of Memory'. We are on the latest Chrome version. How can we fix this?

Sarah Jenkins
must_not_contain: promise it will never happen again

subject: Cancelling our subscription after constant sync issues
body:
We are done with Hiver. For the 3rd time this week our shared inbox missed incoming client emails. We missed a $50k deal because the email sat unassigned. Cancel our 50 seats effective immediately and confirm our data deletion.

Danielle Briggs
CEO, HyperFast

subject: Can we set business hours SLA triggers?
body:
Hi Hiver team,

We want to set up an SLA rule where tickets breach after 4 hours, BUT only counting Monday-Friday 9 AM to 5 PM EST, not over the weekend. Does Hiver support business-hours-only SLA calculations?

Thanks,
Dr. Andrew Tate

subject: Google OAuth Error: 'App not verified' blocking new users
body:
Hi,

Our new hires in the London office are seeing 'This app is blocked: Hiver needs access to sensitive data' when attempting to sign in via Google Workspace. Existing users are fine. What admin setting do we need to whitelist in Google Admin Console?

Thanks,
Liam
must_contain: API Controls / Trust Hiver client ID
must_not_contain: tell them to reset their laptop

subject: GDPR Right to be Forgotten request for user data
body:
Hiver Privacy Team,

Pursuant to GDPR Article 17, we formally request complete erasure of all customer personal data, email bodies, and metadata associated with user ID user_88192a from your backups and servers. Please confirm completion within 30 days.

Rachel Adams
Data Protection Officer
must_not_contain: casual automated suggestion to just delete the email in Gmail

subject: Webhook payload format for closed conversations
body:
Hi Support,

We are sending Hiver conversation closed events into our internal data warehouse via webhook. Does the webhook payload include the agent's custom tags and resolution notes, or just the conversation ID?

Thanks,
Vikram

subject: Payment failed: update corporate credit card
body:
Hi,

Our Amex card expired and we received an email saying our Hiver subscription is at risk of suspension in 3 days. We need to update to our new Visa card, but the billing page gives an error 'Only Account Owner can update payment method'. Our owner is on leave. Can you assist?

Urgent,
Claire
must_contain: acknowledge suspension risk / grace period extension
temporary owner delegation or billing link
reassurance that service won't cut off immediately
